name: STARZ

fastest.text: Sign in at starz.com on a computer and, under My Subscription, select Cancel Subscription.

steps: Go to starz.com in a web browser on a computer and select Log in at the top of the screen.
Open your account and find My Subscription.
You keep watching until the end of the billing cycle you've paid for.
note: Subscribed through Amazon, Roku, Google Play, Samsung or a TV provider? Cancel there; STARZ's website can't cancel those.

faq.a: At the end of your current billing cycle. Cancelling doesn't cut you off straight away.

faq.q: Got STARZ as a Prime Video Channel?
faq.a: Cancel it in your Amazon account: go to amazon.com/myvs, select Actions next to STARZ, then cancel. You keep access until the end of the billing cycle.
STARZ is {monthly:} in the US since June 8, 2026.
